READABILITY.evidence: Names are clear (batchDurabilityState, registerSyncJob, completeSyncJob, terminalErrLocked, wakeAllWaitersLocked). Public types and fields are documented, and the context-precedence logic has a comment. Formatting matches pebble.

MAINTAINABILITY.evidence: The new durability.go is 669 lines, over the 500-line cap. The wake/compact loops for seqWaiters and notifySubs are copy-pasted. hasUserBatchDurable spots the default via reflect.ValueOf(...).Pointer(), which is fragile. The tracker is fed from both commit.go and Batch.SyncWait.

ROBUSTNESS.evidence: applyInternal no longer calls Logger.Fatalf when batch.commitErr != nil and returns the error, though the commit pipeline may be left broken. The reflect-pointer default check is fragile. Otherwise errors latch correctly, close wakes all waiters, retention is bounded and limits are named constants.

C6-02-CASE1.evidence: The API changes are additive. But every Sync commit allocates a batchDurabilityState and takes the tracker mutex inside prepare (under p.mu) even when BatchDurable is unset. The Fatalf-to-return change on WAL sync failure also changes existing commit behaviour.
